items.verbatim: SBIR PHASE I: DEVELOPMENT OF A COMPACT MAGNETIC RESONANCE RELAXOMETRY SENSOR OPERATING AT 0.1 TESLA FOR MEASURING IOHEXOL CONCENTRATION IN BLOOD SAMPLES -THE BROADER IMPACT/COMMERCIAL POTENTIAL OF THIS SMALL BUSINESS INNOVATION RESEARCH (SBIR) PHASE I PROJECT IS TO DEVELOP A LOW-COST, PORTABLE DIAGN
